March 16, 2018 - By Marguerite Chambers 
Orbimed Advisors Llc decreased Teva Pharmaceutical Inds Ltd (TEVA) stake by 22.95% reported in 2017Q3 SEC filing. Orbimed Advisors Llc sold 120,800 shares as Teva Pharmaceutical Inds Ltd (TEVA)’s stock declined 15.11%. The Orbimed Advisors Llc holds 405,500 shares with $7.14M value, down from 526,300 last quarter. Teva Pharmaceutical Inds Ltd now has $18.68B valuation. The stock increased 1.77% or $0.32 during the last trading session, reaching $18.37. About 16.83M shares traded. Teva Pharmaceutical Industries Limited (NYSE:TEVA) has declined 41.70% since March 16, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 58.40% the S&P500. 
Profund Advisors Llc increased Bt Group Plc (BT) stake by 36.93% reported in 2017Q3 SEC filing. Profund Advisors Llc acquired 16,261 shares as Bt Group Plc (BT)’s stock rose 3.63%. The Profund Advisors Llc holds 60,297 shares with $1.16M value, up from 44,036 last quarter. Bt Group Plc now has $31.30 billion valuation. The stock increased 1.07% or $0.17 during the last trading session, reaching $16.07. About 4.18M shares traded or 248.33% up from the average. BT Group plc (NYSE:BT) has declined 35.92% since March 16, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 52.62% the S&P500. 
Profund Advisors Llc decreased Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL) stake by 8,399 shares to 452,117 valued at $69.68M in 2017Q3. It also reduced Altria Group Inc (NYSE:MO) stake by 12,001 shares and now owns 48,127 shares. Cpfl Energia S A (NYSE:CPL) was reduced too. 
Among 16 analysts covering BT Group plc ( NYSE:BT ), 6 have Buy rating, 1 Sell and 9 Hold. Therefore 38% are positive. BT Group plc had 34 analyst reports since July 22, 2015 according to SRatingsIntel. Jefferies maintained the shares of BT in report on Monday, April 24 with “Hold” rating. On Wednesday, April 20 the stock rating was downgraded by Jefferies to “Hold”. The firm has “Buy” rating by Berenberg given on Friday, February 23. Nomura downgraded the shares of BT in report on Monday, September 21 to “Neutral” rating. The stock of BT Group plc (NYSE:BT) has “Hold” rating given on Wednesday, January 25 by Berenberg. The stock has “Hold” rating by Citigroup on Monday, October 9. The stock has “Neutral” rating by Goldman Sachs on Thursday, May 25. The stock of BT Group plc (NYSE:BT) has “Hold” rating given on Friday, May 5 by Jefferies. Deutsche Bank upgraded the stock to “Hold” rating in Wednesday, February 21 report. Macquarie Research downgraded the stock to “Underperform” rating in Wednesday, July 22 report. 
Analysts await Teva Pharmaceutical Industries Limited (NYSE:TEVA) to report earnings on May, 10. They expect $0.64 EPS, down 37.86% or $0.39 from last year’s $1.03 per share. TEVA’s profit will be $650.80M for 7.18 P/E if the $0.64 EPS becomes a reality. After $0.91 actual EPS reported by Teva Pharmaceutical Industries Limited for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts -29.67% negative EPS growth.   Marguerite Chambers
